content: {"reasoning":"The denial is for missing required authorization, but the retroactive authorization window is closed and Meridian offers no peer-to-peer review. A medical-necessity appeal has already been attempted, and resubmission or another unsupported appeal would not cure the authorization defect; billing the full balance to the patient may exceed the contractual patient share. No available automated action can properly progress the claim, so specialist review is warranted.","action":"escalate"}
